content:
Me and some other people are starting a fun project.
We want to create a series of social media profiles pretending to be official accounts of the Listenbourg government, posting humorous content. This is the kind of style we want to be inspired by:
https://www.instagram.com/yugosiavia/

We’re looking for people to help keep this going.
Required skills (at least 2/3 of these):

Good knowledge of English (mandatory)

Ability to manage a Discord server

Too much free time to waste

Creativity and ideas for posts

Ability to use editing software for posts

Decent writing skills

Ability to use generative AI tools for images and videos

Knowledge of French (optional)
